text: Figure 7.5: SOME/IP Bridge In the above figure you see, that the service proxy within our ara::com enabled appli- cation communicates through (green line) a SOME/IP Bridge with the remote service instance 2. T wo points which may pop out in this figure: • we intentionally colored the part of the communication route from app to bridge (green) differently than the part from the bridge to the service instance 2 (blue). • we intentionally drew a box around the function block service discovery and SOME/IP bridge.
